description: This file contains API client functions for authentication-related operations, including fetching user organizations by email and logging in with organization ID, email, and password. It imports configuration, utility functions for hashing, and URL resolution, and exports functions that perform network requests and handle responses.

methods.name: fetchUserOrganizationsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with a given email address by making a GET request to the auth API.

methods.name: loginWithOrgEmailPassword
methods.description: Performs login using organization ID, email, and password, encrypts the organization ID, sends a POST request, and processes the response to return an authentication token and payload.
